_description: CVE experiment matrix with the ALTERNATE ordinal target = CVSS base severity (independent of the EPSS-derived priority_score). Identical structure to experiments.json but base.stage1_config points at the CVSS target config, so the converter fills the priority_score/priority_band slots from CVSS. Run under a separate --output-root (e.g. cve_domain/runs/experiments_cvss) so it never collides with the priority-target runs. Purpose: show the ontology-guided ordinal method is not tuned to one label definition — it transfers to a second, independent notion of vulnerability priority on the same corpus.

experiments.name: no-stage1 baseline (CVSS target)
experiments.description: Stage 2 supervised heads over FROZEN base embeddings, no Stage 1. Reference for the value of ordinal Stage 1 on the CVSS target.

experiments.name: baseline ordinal contrastive (CVSS target)
experiments.description: Ordinal Stage 1 (same-band positives + cross-band negatives) with ontology-tiered negatives and no sample weighting.

experiments.name: hard-negative emphasis (CVSS target)
experiments.description: E1 with a harder negative mix (0.7/0.2/0.1) to test whether emphasizing ontology-hard negatives sharpens the CVSS-severity embedding.

experiments.name: ontology-refined positives (CVSS target)
experiments.description: Positives must share the anchor's CVSS-severity band AND (preferably) an ontology token, falling back to same-band-only. Tests whether adding topical relatedness on top of the severity alignment helps vs the pure same-band positives in E1. (E8/E9 from the priority matrix are omitted: under the ordinal base config they resolve identically to E1/E7 respectively.)
